resources.string: A physical SIM is in the hybrid tray (slot 1). Move it to the other slot to keep using it, or proceed to disconnect that SIM and enable eSIM.
Enabling eSIM switches the hybrid SIM tray slot to the built-in eUICC (tsds2). The physical SIM in that slot will be unavailable while eSIM is enabled.
Slot switch failed. Try again in a few seconds.
